[TIP: Play Event Stories!]
You can collect tokens and perform Limit Breaks on event-exclusive S Memorias!
The more Limit Breaks you perform on a character, the higher her max level gets!
Ruka's S-rank [Passing Moment of Reprieve] Memoria,\nobtainable from the "Summer, Swimsuits, and Tropical Festivals!" story event,\ncan acquire a fire-based skill that attacks all enemies!
Such fire-element offensive skills are useful when battling enemies that are vulnerable to fire,\nso make the most of them!

The gemstones you obtain from these gem flashback battles
can be used to craft accessories.

Higher difficulty levels reap greater gem rewards,
so rise to the challenge by strengthening your squad's rating,
and create the most powerful accessories that you can!

[TIP: Make the Most of Auto-Battle Mode!]
You can change how your squad acts in auto-battle mode, such as when to perform offensive skills or trigger overdrive, via the Auto Battle Advanced Settings sub-menu.

The "Oubliette of Tears" course has been added to the Garden of Memories' dungeon.\nThe gemstone "tears" found within there are enhancement items\nused to unlock passive powers and other attributes.
Flashback battle and dungeon passes can be won from limited-time score challenge events.
Try it out and see how good you are!
You've unlocked the Orb Boss battles option in the Power Training menu.
When you first defeat an Orb Boss, you will receive an orb that,\nwhile equipped, will grant that unit an exclusive skill.

Repeatedly defeating the Orb Boss with that orb equipped
will allow your unit to gain proficiency in that orb's skill.
Once their proficiency reaches 100%,
they will be able to use that orb's skill without having to equip the orb.

The higher the boss's level, the more powerful their attacks become.
To reduce the damage incurred by them on your squad,
try equipping the exclusive accessories which that kind of boss occasionally drop
when you take on their higher-level versions.
You can attempt to fight Orb Bosses from the Power Training menu.

[TIP: Limit Break Your Memorias!]
When you perform Limit Breaks on your Memorias, you increase their attributes and max level. Further, the "Inspiring Spark" passive power that many SS Memorias possess, will grant an additional +1 SP while that squad member is in the front line.
Protean shards (SS), that can be used to Limit Break any SS-rank Memoria,\nare obtainable as prizes from the Token Exchange of each story event.
Collect and cash in tokens at the story event Token Exchange\nin order to obtain such prizes that help power up your squad members further!
